_about: Seed for reporting.voice_lint (standing cut/use rulings from the September 2026 review round). Copy the brand's own reporting.voice_lint from context.yaml into this shape (a list of banned phrases, or {banned: [], cut: [{cut, use}]}) and pass it to prose-lint.py --voice-lint. A phrase under `cut` is a finding wherever it appears; `use` is the replacement the finding suggests.

cut.cut: did all of it and then some
cut.use: was the sole driver of revenue growth
ad sales increased on falling spend
fell on higher demand, not lower stock
name the measure and the threshold
name the measure and the threshold
